insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific disease waiting per IRDAI list; AYUSH up to 100% SI

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: General Ward room rent capped at Rs 450 per day; surgical sub-limits per schedule (e.g. cataract Rs 10,800; hysterectomy Rs 22,500; appendicectomy Rs 16,200; angiography Rs 12,000; CABG/angioplasty/knee replacement up to SI)

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed procedures including angiography, angioplasty, hernia repair, lithotripsy, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, eye surgery, dialysis

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Treatment exceeding 3 days at home when hospitalisation not possible

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for Ayurveda/Yoga/Naturopathy/Unani/Siddha/Homeopathy

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Hospitalisation expenses excluding cost of organ; within recipient's SI

room_rent_capping: General Ward up to Rs 450 per day
notable_exclusions_summary: Basic, low-premium mediclaim covering only essential hospitalisation. Maternity excluded. Tight surgical sub-limit schedule (e.g. cataract Rs 10,800, hysterectomy Rs 22,500). General-ward room rent capped at Rs 450/day.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital with pre-authorisation; reimbursement via document submission within prescribed period. Helpline and grievance via newindia.co.in. ABHA-enabled.
